news.title: Apple's post-earnings margin concerns weigh on the Dow; Nasdaq-100 futures lead on a chip-stock rebound
news.text: Apple shares are under pressure after its 2 Nov report flagged rising memory-chip costs pressuring gross margin, dragging the price-weighted Dow. Nasdaq-100 futures are the relative outperformer as chip names rebound, even with the index still reported >10% below its all-time closing high (confirms yesterday's brief notice).

news.title: Eaton (ETN, our own technical pick) beats with record Q3 2026 results, raises guidance
news.text: Adjusted EPS $3.68 vs ~$3.54 consensus; sales $8.9-8.95B, +28% y/y, a record; segment margins a record 25.3%. Raised Q4 EPS guide to $4.05-4.15 and FY2026 to $13.70-13.80. Stock up ~6.6% pre-market off a depressed base -- still well below its own entry zone (452.01-456.53) and stop (429.40).
